mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (user1_id, user2_id, product_id, last_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{user1Id}, #{user2Id}, #{productId}, #{lastTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time = IF(product_id IS NULL AND VALUES(product_id) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(update_time), update_time), product_id = COALESCE(product_id, VALUES(product_id))

INSERT INTO conversation (user1_id, user2_id, product_id, last_message_id, last_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{user1Id}, #{user2Id}, #{productId}, #{lastMessageId}, #{lastTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_time = IF(last_message_id IS NULL OR last_message_id < VALUES(last_message_id), VALUES(last_time), last_time), update_time = IF(last_message_id IS NULL OR last_message_id < VALUES(last_message_id), VALUES(update_time), update_time), product_id = COALESCE(product_id, VALUES(product_id)), last_message_id = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_message_id, 0), VALUES(last_message_id))
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS conversationId, CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{me} THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END AS peerId, c.product_id AS productId, c.last_message_id AS lastId, m.content AS lastContent, COALESCE(m.create_time, c.last_time) AS lastTime, COALESCE(unread.unreadCount, 0) AS unreadCount, u.nickname AS peerNickname, u.username AS peerUsername, u.avatar AS peerAvatar FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN message m ON c.last_message_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT from_user_id AS peerId, COUNT(*) AS unreadCount FROM message WHERE to_user_id = #{me} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY from_user_id ) unread ON unread.peerId = CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{me} THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{me} THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END WHERE c.user1_id = #{me} OR c.user2_id = #{me} ORDER BY c.last_time DESC, c.id DESC
